## Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Motivation

What problem does this feature solve? Explain why it would be useful and who would benefit from it.

## Use Case

Describe a concrete scenario showing how the feature would be used.

```text
As a ..., I want ..., so that ...
```

## Proposed Behavior

Describe how the feature should work from the user's perspective.

## Proposed Solution

Describe a possible technical approach, if you have one. This section is optional; alternative implementations may be considered.

## Affected Areas

- [ ] Board support or hardware drivers
- [ ] Display, touch, or LVGL port
- [ ] GUI screens or widgets
- [ ] Models or application services
- [ ] Internal storage or SD card
- [ ] Logging
- [ ] USB networking
- [ ] DHCP or DNS
- [ ] Web UI or HTTP API
- [ ] CAN or automotive protocols
- [ ] OTA or firmware management
- [ ] Build system or CI
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Requirements and Constraints

List relevant requirements or limitations, such as:

- supported hardware revisions;
- RAM, flash, or storage usage;
- real-time or throughput requirements;
- ESP-IDF, LVGL, browser, or operating-system compatibility;
- USB descriptor or network compatibility;
- safety, security, or authentication requirements;
- backward compatibility with configuration or stored data.

## Acceptance Criteria

Define observable conditions that would make the feature complete.

- [ ]
- [ ]
- [ ]

## Alternatives Considered

Describe alternative solutions, workarounds, or approaches and why they may be less suitable.

## Additional Information

Add mockups, diagrams, protocol documentation, links, logs, or technical notes when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and discussions for similar requests
- [ ] The request describes a problem or use case, not only an implementation
- [ ] I considered compatibility and resource constraints
- [ ] I removed private or sensitive device information from attachments
